subject: Dataflow diagram + CAIQ control mapping for vendor onboarding (ApexFin)
messages:
From: Lara Cheng <lara.cheng@apexfin.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: security-portal@apexfin.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Dataflow diagrams and CAIQ mapping for Redwood Inference

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for progressing the vendor intake. As part of our last security review we need two items to complete the CAIQ mapping and control evidence for Apex Financial's procurement:

1) A system/dataflow diagram showing boundaries for PII and tokenized data flows (network, S3, KMS, runtime).
2) A filled CAIQ-to-control mapping (CSV or XLSX) that maps Redwood controls to the CAIQ questions we flagged.

We prefer files uploaded to our OneTrust portal (security-portal@apexfin.com) but can accept a presigned S3 link if that's easier. Can you confirm whether you can:
- Upload directly to OneTrust
- Or provide a presigned S3 URL and a filename convention we should expect

Would appreciate those by EOD 2027-07-01 if possible — procurement is on a tight cadence. If you have any high-level control narratives (SOC 2 mapping, retention windows for logs) that will speed the review, please include them.

Regards,
Lara Cheng
Senior Security Analyst
Apex Financial Technologies

- We'll upload the dataflow diagram and mapping to your OneTrust portal (preferred). If we hit portal throttling, I'll send a presigned S3 link and follow the filename convention: REDWOOD_<account>_<YYYYMMDD>_<artifact>.<ext>
- Monica will prepare the CAIQ mapping CSV and include short control narratives for SOC 2 alignment (CC6, CC7, etc.).
- We'll also include a small runtime logging sample and a note on retention windows.

Action items (internal): Monica to assemble assets; Marissa to handle OneTrust upload and confirm receipt.

I'll aim to have the upload completed by EOD 2027-07-01 and will flag here if we need additional time.

Thanks,

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: CAIQ mapping + dataflow draft (staging)

Hi Lara / Mateo,

I've attached the first pass of the artifacts for your intake:
- redwood_dataflow_v1.pdf (annotated network and storage boundaries)
- caiq_mapping_apex_template.csv (columns: CAIQ_ID, CAIQ_Question, REDWOOD_CONTROL_ID, Narrative, Evidence_File)
- runtime-logging-sample.log (scrubbed sample)

Notes on the mapping:
- Control narratives include where the control is implemented (runtime, infra, or vendor management).
- We've mapped SOC 2 CC6/CC7 items where applicable and added references to our SOC 2 report (section references included).
- Evidence_File column currently references the filenames above; once uploaded to OneTrust I'll update those to portal attachment IDs.

Open questions for Apex:
- For CAIQ question CAIQ-PRIV-12, do you need a formal policy PDF or is a narrative + log sample sufficient?
- Confirm retention window for runtime logs you require for sampling (30/90/365 days) — we'll attach a retention statement.

Marissa, I'll hand the three files to you for upload to OneTrust. I'll also create a short README that describes the mapping logic.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Onboarding Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_dataflow_v1.pdf, caiq_mapping_apex_template.csv, runtime-logging-sample.log
From: Lara Cheng <lara.cheng@apexfin.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: security-portal@apexfin.com
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + dataflow draft (staging)

Thanks Monica — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications:

- The CSV layout looks good; we prefer the Evidence_File values to be the OneTrust attachment names (so we can reconcile automatically). If you can't upload first, we'll accept the filenames and map them after upload.
- For CAIQ-PRIV-12, a narrative + scrubbing/log sample is acceptable for now; we may ask for a formal policy PDF later in procurement.
- Retention window: we need 90 days of runtime logging for sampling. Could you confirm that logs are retained that long and whether we can request a filtered extract on demand?

If you can upload the three files and confirm the retention answer by EOD today, we'll mark the intake as 'ready for review' and pass to our SOC team.

Appreciate the quick turn.

Best,
Lara Cheng
Senior Security Analyst
Apex Financial Technologies
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lara Cheng <lara.cheng@apexfin.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + dataflow draft (staging)

Hi Lara — quick follow-up to confirm:

- Marissa has uploaded the three files to the Apex OneTrust portal this morning. Portal IDs and links: (OneTrust: attachment IDs will be posted to the ticket; if you want the presigned S3 mirrors I can provide them).
- Logs retention: Redwood retains runtime request logs (non-PII request metadata and error traces) for 90 days by default. We can produce filtered extracts on demand and can provide a signed statement of retention policy. We do not retain raw user prompt text beyond configured customer retention settings (we'll include a short control narrative to make that explicit).
- Next steps: I'll post the OneTrust attachment IDs into this thread and share the CAIQ updated CSV with Evidence_File values replaced by portal attachment names once I have the IDs.

Thanks for coordinating — let us know if the SOC team needs any targeted samples.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Partnerships - Security Onboarding
Redwood Inference
